name: Head Counter
summary: Tracks public Automaton release download proxies, excluding our own checks.

application.description: Keeps daily public release download snapshots and subtracts our reported downloads; these are not counts of server installs or updates.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py index.html page.js dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

secrets.name: HEAD_COUNTER_TOKEN
secrets.description: Shared secret of at least 16 characters for own-download reports and summary.json.
